title: Module 14: The accounting equation, linked statements and enterprise assurance

questions.q: In "The accounting equation Understand: explain", which of these is a key idea?
o: Revenue when earned, not when paid

questions.q: In "Double entry and the trial balance Apply: record", which of these is a key idea?
o: The two sides always stay equal
Trial balance checks the whole ledger
Each event changes at least two items

questions.q: In "The income statement Apply: prepare", which of these is a key idea?
o: Each entry has equal debits and credits
Operating: profit plus depreciation minus rise in receivables

questions.q: In "The balance sheet Apply: prepare", which of these is a key idea?
o: Equity includes the profit kept in the firm

questions.q: In "The cash flow statement Apply: prepare", which of these is a key idea?
o: List assets, then liabilities, then equity

questions.q: In "Linking the three statements Analyse: trace", which of these is a key idea?
o: Each event changes at least two items
Depreciation lowers assets and profit together

questions.q: In "Ratios Evaluate: interpret", which of these is a key idea?
o: Depreciation spreads the cost of equipment
List assets, then liabilities, then equity
